hotel.name: JW Marriott Savannah Plant Riverside District

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of historic Savannah on the riverfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: is located in the heart of historic Savannah on the riverfront

verified_facts.text: Plant Riverside District was once a power plant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once a power plant, Plant Riverside District now represents the beauty of progress.

verified_facts.text: The hotel spans three buildings: the Power Plant, the Three Muses and the Atlantic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from our three beautifully themed buildings the Power Plant, the Three Muses, or the Atlantic

verified_facts.text: The Power Plant lobby features a life-size, chrome-dipped dinosaur.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step inside the expansive lobby, complete with a life-size, chrome-dipped dinosaur

verified_facts.text: The Power Plant's rooms retain historic architectural details paired with modern-industrial styling.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Power Plant's hotel rooms retain historic architectural details paired with modern-industrial stylings perfect for relaxing and recharging.

verified_facts.text: Three Muses guestrooms have soft, sophisticated colors and are adorned with magical realist art.
verified_facts.excerpt: the guestrooms reveal soft and sophisticated colors and are adorned with magical realist art

verified_facts.text: The Atlantic building is inspired by a bespoke journey aboard a luxury yacht.
verified_facts.excerpt: Handsome and stately, the Atlantic invites guests on a getaway inspired by a bespoke journey aboard a luxury yacht.

verified_facts.text: The Executive Studio suite has a living area with sofa bed, a marble walk-in bathtub and floor-to-ceiling views of the Savannah Riverfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: luxurious executive suite featuring a living area with sofa bed, marble walk-in bathtub and floor-to-ceiling views of the Savannah Riverfront

verified_facts.text: The rooftop Compass Pool Lounge is available exclusively to hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooftop Compass Pool Lounge available exclusively for guests staying at the JW Marriott Savannah

verified_facts.text: Cabana and daybed packages are offered at the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Cabana or Daybed Package will elevate your stay.

verified_facts.text: Poseidon Spa offers massages, HydraFacials and Wellness Rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax with a massage, prepare for an event with a HydraFacial, or treat yourself with one of our Wellness Rituals.

verified_facts.text: District Live, powered by Live Nation, is the onsite music venue bringing concerts to the riverfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rock out at District Live powered by Live Nation our onsite music venue which brings world-class concerts to the riverfront

verified_facts.text: Myrtle & Rose Rooftop Bar has views of both the river and the historic district.
verified_facts.excerpt: this romantic rooftop bar in Savannah, GA, will transport guests with breathtaking views of both the majestic river and charming historic district

verified_facts.text: Private dining is offered inside the hotel's 100-plus-year-old smokestack.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us within the core of our 100+ year-old Smokestack for a private dining experience.

verified_facts.text: There are 24/7 fitness centers in each of the Power Plant, Three Muses and Atlantic buildings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit one of our 24/7 Fitness Centers, located within the Power Plant, Three Muses, and Atlantic buildings

verified_facts.text: The riverwalk outside has high-end shops and galleries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend some time wandering along the riverwalk and uncover high-end shops and galleries

verified_facts.text: Baobab Lounge serves wine, cocktails and small plates alongside artwork from regions throughout Africa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover and sample a curated selection of wine, cocktails, and small plates, as well as modern and traditional artwork from different regions throughout Africa.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is owned by the Kessler Collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is part of JW Marriott, Marriott's highest tier hotel, but owned by the luxury Kessler Collection.

verified_facts.text: Life-size dinosaur skeletons and fossils, backlit in bright colors, are displayed throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: including life size dinosaur skeletons and fossils, backlit in a range of bright colors, displayed throughout the walls

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of anywhere in town.
verified_facts.excerpt: is walking distance from anywhere in town you want to be

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler found the spa and gym on the smaller side.
verified_facts.excerpt: They were on the smaller side but seemed to do the trick.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the riverfront area as a little touristy.
verified_facts.excerpt: It seems like a nice slice of the city, if a little touristy (hence the gift shops).

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.

verified_facts.text: A one-hour tour explores Plant Riverside District, blending history and surprise.
verified_facts.excerpt: discover how Plant Riverside District intertwines the past and future on an unforgettable one-hour tour
